subject: English
question_text: Write the summary of the passage in no more than
guide_solution: Summary The passage is about the use of social networking service. Social network have opened the way to the users to be known to the whole world. They are easy and simple to use. They are cost free. They can easily interconnect the users of the whole world. So people of all ages are using these websites. They can share their interest and activities. They can present themselves before the world by presenting their personal profiles, by uploading pictures and multimedia contents. Because of all these facilities social medias have become more popular and the number of users is increasing day by day.  অনুবাদ(Passage No. 2) : শ্রীলংকা এশিয়ার একটি দেশ। ইহা দÿিণ এশিয়ায় অবস্থিত। ভারত মহাসাগরে এর অবস্থান। প্রাকৃতিকভাবে ইহা খুব সুন্দর। সারা পৃথিবীর ভ্রমণকারীরা এখানে মাসে এবং অবসর সময় কাটায়। শ্রীলংকার মোট আয়তন ৬৫,০০০ বগর্ কিলোমিটার। ইহা বিভিন্ন ধমের্র দেশ। এর জনসংখ্যা ২০ মিলিয়ন। মালদ্বীপ ও দÿিণ এশিয়ার একটি দেশ। ইহা খুব ছোট একটি দেশ। আসলেই, ইহা এশিয়ার সবচেয়ে ছোট দেশ। এর অবস্থান ভারত মহাসাগরের একটি দ্বীপ দেশ। ইহা 149 district. A famous Saint named Shah Farid was living in the town. According to his name the district is named Faridpur. The political situation in the town is normal. People here are very amiable and hospitable. Padma river is not far away from the town. Though small, it is a well decorated town. I invite you warmly to visit my town. I’m really proud of my town. No more today. Waiting eagerly for your next letter. Take care Yours ever Salam.
source: SSC English 1st Paper Test Paper 102 — Govt. Agragami Girls' High School, Sylhet
